question: A cylindrical pillar is 84 cm in diameter and 5 m in height. Find the cost of painting the curved surface of the pillar at the rate of Rs. 15 per m². (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Height of cylindrical pillar = 5m 

Diameter of cylindrical pillar = 84cm

**Formula used:**

The curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh 

Diameter = 2r 

**Calculation:**

The curved surface area of the cylindrical pillar 

⇒ 2 × (22/7)× (84/200) × 5 ∴ 1m = 100cm

⇒ 13.2 m

**Total cost = 13.2 × 15 = Rs. 198**
